constraint: Use semantic HTML5 elements (header, main, section, footer, nav)
check: verify no div-soup — every major container uses a semantic tag

constraint: Fully responsive using CSS Grid for main layout and Flexbox for component alignment
check: verify CSS Grid is used for page layout, no fixed pixel widths on containers

constraint: No inline styles — all styling through CSS custom properties in :root
check: verify zero style= attributes in the HTML

constraint: Use color palette: primary #1A1A2E, secondary #16213E, accent #E94560, surface #F5F5F5
check: verify these colors appear as CSS custom properties and are used in interactive elements

constraint: All images must have descriptive alt text, decorative ones use alt="" with role="presentation"
check: verify all img tags have alt attributes, decorative images use empty alt

constraint: No JavaScript for layout or styling — JS only for interactivity
check: verify no JS-based layout/styling, only event handlers and animations

constraint: Include skip-to-content link as first focusable element
check: verify a skip link exists early in the DOM with appropriate href
